head: codex/5498-v0918-wp10a-task-context-adapter
title: [v0.91.8][WP-10A] Add bounded Codex task and context adapter
body:
Closes #5498

Adds a small async ADL v2 adapter for conductor-approved task create, attach, message, handoff, inspect, cancel, and escalate operations. Requests bind to verified issue/claim/worktree/path authority, bounded context digests, deadlines, and idempotency keys; receipts retain only sanitized identifiers, status, digests, and evidence references.

Task-level serialization closes cancellation races, repeated terminal cancellation replays without redispatch, terminal observations block later messages and handoffs, and timeout results remain explicitly indeterminate. Focused FastWork proof passes 15/15 tests, strict all-target Clippy, formatting, dependency/ancestry checks, diff hygiene, and LoC budgets. The single GPT-5.5 pre-PR review cycle resolved every finding and finished with zero blockers. No Runtime v2, AWS, raw gh, provider calls, or private transcript retention.
